answer: dune fixes its seat count, and a fable enters only by burning the entry of a live seat, so clones consume identities rather than create them. Each burn must exceed the highest bond recorded in dune and rewrites that high, applied one burn at a time at commit, so the kth clone burns k signal and no batch shares the price. The attacker must buy seats from a supply that only contracts and ends holding no more seats than before, paying the top bond per clone. It breaks if seats transfer without a burn or dune can mint seats.
